- First pass: mn = n+1 (47). For each maybe[i], if mn < nw then ok[i]=1, else mn = nw. So ok[i] = 1 if some earlier maybe value is smaller than it.
- Second pass: mx = -1. For i from end to start, if mx > nw then ok[i] = 1, else mx = nw. So ok[i] = 1 if some later maybe value is larger than it.
- Return true iff all maybe elements have ok = 1.

So valid means: every element in (l..r) that's strictly between dw and up must have either a smaller element before it (within the maybe set) or a larger element after it (within the maybe set).
